verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an identity and payments layer for agents, and such a platform could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring automations, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents building blocks: token creation, charging, the MCP server tools, and an auto-created buyer agent. There is no evidence of a scheduler, triggers, or background automations that Skyfire itself runs. Autonomous behavior would have to be built by the user's own agent, which earns no credit.
